**(a) Social posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will double the pace of scientific discovery. We should prepare now for a transformation that could help researchers make breakthroughs faster across fields.

2. We believe superintelligent AI, built within the next 20 years, will double the pace of scientific discovery. That means a faster path from questions to answers—and a chance to accelerate progress on some of humanity’s biggest challenges.

3. We are entering a new era of science. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will double the pace of discovery. We need to meet that moment with ambition, preparation, and a clear focus on public benefit.

**(b) Newsletter opening (104 words)**

We believe superintelligent AI will double the pace of scientific discovery if it is built within the next 20 years. That would mark a profound shift in how quickly researchers can test ideas, uncover patterns, and develop new solutions. From understanding complex systems to finding better ways to address urgent challenges, faster discovery could reshape what progress looks like across many fields. This possibility is not a distant abstraction; the choices we make today will help determine whether society is ready to use these tools wisely and share their benefits broadly. We are focused on meeting this moment with ambition, careful preparation, and a commitment to putting scientific progress to work for everyone.
